hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */index.html|index.html) cd /home/user/Legion-Galaxy && python3 -c "import re; s=open('index.html').read(); open('/tmp/g.js','w').write(re.search(r'<script>(.*)</script>', s, re.S).group(1))" && node --check /tmp/g.js && echo 'index.html: <script> syntax OK';; esac; }
